svg.title: GD training loss
svg.desc: A line connects training loss J=MSE/2 after 0 through 80 completed gradient-descent updates. All three initial coefficients are zero, the learning rate is 0.2, and there are four training samples. Loss decreases from 7.75 to about 0.002054862 after 80 updates. No test loss is shown.
